title: PATCH /sessions/{sessionId}/exercises/{exerciseId} — Request Body
description: Logs completion data for one exercise within an active session. Sent after the patient finishes all sets.

setsCompleted.description: Number of sets the patient actually completed (may be less than the plan target)

repsPerSet.description: Rep count recorded per set; array length must equal setsCompleted

formScore.description: Aggregate form quality score 0.0–1.0 produced by the on-device CV model

durationSeconds.description: Total elapsed wall-clock time for this exercise in seconds
